description: This Java class defines an Android instrumentation test for measuring the launch performance of a specific activity (ComplexActivity). It extends a base performance class and overrides lifecycle methods to initiate and conclude performance testing.

classes.name: ComplexActivityLaunchPerformance
classes.description: Instrumentation class for measuring the launch performance of ComplexActivity, extending LaunchPerformanceBase and overriding lifecycle methods to run the performance test.

methods.name: ComplexActivityLaunchPerformance
methods.description: Constructor that calls the superclass constructor.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the onCreate method to set up the intent for the activity to be tested and starts the performance measurement.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides onStart to run the LaunchApp method and then finish the test with a result code.
